headline: Sasken Technologies announces date for earnings conference call
hook: Sasken schedules upcoming quarterly earnings discussion
summary: Sasken Technologies has formally notified the NSE regarding its upcoming earnings call. This filing is a standard regulatory requirement under SEBI Listing Regulations. The call provides a platform for management to discuss the company's financial performance for the recent quarter.
whats_next: Earnings call date to be announced in subsequent filings
why_it_matters: Upcoming management commentary may influence short-term stock price volatility.

headline: Sasken Technologies schedules a board meeting for October 28, 2026
hook: Upcoming board meeting at Sasken Technologies
summary: Sasken Technologies Limited has officially notified the stock exchanges that its board of directors will meet on October 28, 2026. While the specific agenda items have not been detailed in the exchange filing, such routine meetings typically address financial performance and corporate updates. Retail investors holding shares in the company should await the official disclosures resulting from this upcoming session.
why_it_matters: Upcoming corporate disclosures may impact Sasken stock price

headline: Sasken Technologies sets November 3, 2026, as record date for dividend
hook: Record date set for Sasken payout
summary: Sasken Technologies has announced that November 3, 2026, will serve as the record date for determining shareholders eligible for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders owning the stock as of this date will receive the payout. For retail investors holding the shares, this confirms the timeline for the corporate action.
whats_next: Dividend payout following the November 3, 2026 record date
why_it_matters: Eligibility date locked for your Sasken dividend payout
